title: Super simple and effective Habit Tracking App
body:
It’s the most simplest to use Habit Tracker yet detailed enough to satisfy most nit pickers ! 
Layout is great and recording is super quick !
Recording and then undoing if needed is also quick in case you realise you marked something incorrectly. Decent tracking of the stats as well. 
Overall, great app from features perspective and being a user for several years, I know that the developer of this app really cares about customer feedback and incorporates those improvements whenever feasible.
Thanks for this lovely app and good luck for more success on this app and more !! 🙏🏻👍🏻

title: Love this app
body:
Pros: Extremely easy to use and in less than 2 minutes you can tick as many items as you wish with your choice. red/green bars also make it easy to visually analyze the trend of that particular activity. Amidst other applications which do similar activity, I find this most user-friendly and slick. Works well with the iPad in 1x and 2x mode but would really appreciate a separate app with similar UI.

Cons: I think its a bit expensive at $3.99. Maybe I'll wait for a holiday sale of some kind to purchase this app.
